links.comparator_used: The non-integrated ESDR data transfer tool, accessed through an external web link outside hospital systems (an internal contrast within the study, not a randomized comparison)
links.outcome: Disruption of routine clinical workflow and physician burden
links.effect: AI software integrated with PACS: 93.3% (14/15) of secondary hospital physicians said it did not interfere with routine practice. ESDR tool, not integrated: 55.6% (5/9) of respiratory physicians reported a substantial burden on daily tasks, and 5/8 (62.5%) of tertiary physicians reported workflow disruption.
links.tradeoff: The non-integrated ESDR tool required manual uploads and retrieval. Only 28% (7/25) of referral records were complete. Only 44.4% (4/9) of secondary physicians reviewed the final diagnostic results. Only 50% (4/8) of tertiary physicians uploaded final results.
links.quote: With respect to integration into clinical workflows, 93.3% (14/15) of physicians at the secondary hospital reported that the AI-assisted diagnostic software did not interfere with routine clinical practice.

design_hint: Integrated implementation strategy with tertiary referral and feedback mechanism
